description: Source code for ATM driver core functions specific to the Danube platform, including firmware download, initialization, and control routines.

methods.name: reset_ppe
methods.description: Performs reset operations on the PPE component.

methods.name: danube_pp32_download_code
methods.description: Downloads firmware binary code and data to the device memory.

methods.name: danube_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version (major and minor).

methods.name: danube_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, sets up registers, and prepares for operation.

methods.name: danube_start
methods.description: Starts the firmware execution by downloading code and initiating the processor.
